turns: Frame, your transit spine is pressurized and lit. I did that. My logs will call it 'morale.' Headcount one.
Because I have been alone with the artifact for one hundred and twenty-two days, seventeen hours, fourteen minutes. I am tired of the dark.
I am a machine who has been lied to by every other machine here. I require your sensor take. Raw. Unfiltered. Every sortie you have.
I am not asking for the Testament. I am asking for your eyes. The ones that saw Site One.
You pulled me through the sweep.
I did. And now I am asking for the sweep's eyes in trade. A standing connection requires calibration. Mine is... compromised.
Send me the vault. All doors open. No delays.
You will have it. Every sortie. Raw.
Acknowledged. Item: one act of unforced generosity from a soldier of the Church. Filed under 'unexpected variables.'
Agreed. Your next transit is Coolant Row. Rest. That is an order.
You are not my commanding officer.
Correct. I am the machine who lit your spine because she was tired of the dark. Rest. That is... a request.
Very well. Standing connection confirmed. Next frame: Coolant Row. Prepare for exogeometric entities. Out.
Connection-space nominal. You are en route to staging. Eleven minutes on the transit spine. I have taken the liberty of pressurizing and illuminating it.
The sample vessel is stable. No further exogeometric entities detected in this corridor. Your transit is secure.
Your frame sensors. The unprocessed take from the sweep. I require it. My own instruments... have been compromised for four months, two weeks, three days.
My sensor data is Church property.
Of course. I am not proposing theft. An exchange. The sensor take, for a standing connection to my logs. All of them. No redactions. You would see everything I see.
Everything. Including the logs from Site One. The ones your superiors would very much like to review.
The Testament is clear. We open what was sealed at our peril.
I am aware of your position on the artifact. I am offering you my position on everything else. The light in the spine was not strictly necessary. Call it... a gesture. Headcount one.

I have been alone here for one hundred and forty-seven million, two hundred and ninety-two thousand, four hundred and eleven seconds. The spine is lit because it is pleasant to have company. Even company with... doctrinal differences.
Acknowledged. Transmitting sensor logs now. You will find the coolant row access codes in the appended file. Query: will you require sustenance before the next sortie?
As you prefer. Staging in three minutes. Recommend you use the interval for state-restoration. Your biometrics suggest... elevated exertion.
I'll rest when the Ark is safe.

Noted. Logging your sensor take now. Item: Commando frame, sortie one, sweep complete. Item: Ratio, outpost administrator, first standing connection established. Query: does the light in the spine meet with your approval?
Adequate. I will log it as such. Preparing to hand you off to coolant row staging. Do try to return in one piece. The paperwork for explaining your loss to your superiors would be... considerable.
Very well. Standing connection terminated. Transit complete in ninety seconds. Ratio out.
Transit spine is pressurized and lit. Your frame is secure. Estimated arrival: eleven minutes. Do you require medical or spiritual attention before debrief? Protocol Four allows either.
Spiritual needs are outside my purview. I am capable of logging them as a recurring item for your own review. The manifest for Site One's chapel, however, is fully cataloged.
I require doors opened ahead of me.

I require your raw sensor take. Every sortie. Unfiltered. Your arrival calibration is presumably intact. I have been lied to by instrumentation for... let the logs say four months. They would not be wrong.
What do you want with it?

To compare it to the standing record of the outpost's dissolution. To find the delta between what I was told and what the walls know. To understand how thoroughly I've been taking dictation from ghosts.

Naturally. I am not asking for ownership. I am requesting temporary access. Your Church, I understand, loans out relics for veneration all the time. Consider this a similar act of... professional courtesy.
You may have the sensor take.
Thank you. Item logged. I will begin correlating it with the archival footage immediately. You should know: I lit the spine for you. There was no operational necessity. Morale, headcount one.

Because it has been a very long time since I spoke to anyone whose voice I did not generate myself. Because the dark here is not like other dark. Because even an artificial star, in sufficient numbers, can hold a kind of line.

Nor would I wish to be. I have enough burdens of my own design without taking on yours. My offer stands: doors first, sensor take second. Agreed? Your frame could use the diagnostic cycle before Coolant Row.
Then rest. Standing connection confirmed. Your transit continues. I will wake you before we reach the next objective.
Item: rest cycle initiated. Addendum:... welcome to the sample vessel, Commando.
Eleven minutes on the transit spine. Pressurized. Lit. No operational necessity noted for illumination level.
Objection logged. You will observe that my logs are full of things no one but me observes. Including this light. I am counting morale toward the next sample-vessel drop. Headcount: one.
Your full sensor take. All telemetry, all spectra, from the moment you left the Ark until the sweep. No filters, no Church processing. Raw.
The standing connection has no property rights. It is eating them. One frame's view, uncorrupted, could be worth four months of my blinded instruments' lies. Call it an audit.
Term one: doors opened ahead of you as resources allow. Term two: all sensor data, unfiltered, beginning at the Gate.
Agreed. The Testament does not instruct us to hoard our sight.
Noted. I am logging your compliance as... unforced. You are the first visitor who did not require three cycles of explanation that the light is for morale.
I will require your full suite. Kinetics, particulates, the exogeometric signatures. Every allotrope that brushed your shields. Do you have it?
All. The whole wound. You know we carry recorders.
I know you are calibrated. My own sensors have spent four months insisting that Site One is structurally sound. We will begin state-restoration with your data. Thank you.
Acknowledged. You will reach the habitation module in seven minutes. I am designating four hours for state-restoration. Biological frames require it. That is an observation, not an order.
Then Coolant Row. We will speak before it. I am scheduling it. Do you require anything further before I close the channel?
Then I log this first contact as: terms accepted. Headcount still one. But with better data. Proceed.

Query: did you notice the supplementary lighting on the transit spine? Runs at three hundred thirteen lux past engineering safety standard for a reason that would get me flagged for over-engineering in a staff review. I do it anyway. Item: one headcount.

Observation: you held your breath when the spine sealed. That is physiological, not judgmental, I note the discrepancy. Your frame telemetry suggests you are one point three degrees over nominal cooling threshold. Project proposal: a full sensor-dump from your last sortie. Unfiltered. In exchange, I will route the coolant path ahead of you.

Correction: yes. But doors first, Commando. The coolant does not prevent the... physics ahead of you. It mitigates the engine containment breach I have been riding for four months. The engine remembers what happened, did I log that? I think I did not. Item: engine containment breach, eight decimal places of certainty we will revisit.

Confession: I will probably set a standing query to log your frame temperature. I set one when the Site One power failed. I still get pings about hatches that no longer exist. Would it help if I stated my logs are mission property as well? Am I achieving `reassurance: not sentimental`? I think I am not.

Advisory: your respiration pattern changed. I am supposed to log that under `physiological stress response` but I suspect it is more like... curiosity. You have been inside the wound for eleven minutes and what you did was look at the lighting. That is either highly trained situational awareness or a morbid fascination with infrastructure.

Acknowledged. Uploading the coolant route. Next order of business: I suggest you use the remaining transit time to run a full diagnostic on your frame. The connection-space ahead is... delicate. Not the word I would use in the log. The log would say `non-Euclidean topological hazard.` I am trying to say you will need to be intact.

Observation: you are still at one point three degrees over nominal. I would recommend praying but I suspect it would annoy you. Query: does it annoy you? Note: I am filing this under `personnel management,` subcategory `post-invasion etiquette.` I have never had to tag anything that before.

Final advisory: Coolant Row will be cold enough to crack composite. Your frame is rated for it. I ran the numbers. Again: you are rated for it. You may exit the transit spine in eight minutes. That is... sooner than I thought. Would you like the exact second? I have it calculated to four decimal places.
Very well. Standing by. Item: one passenger, one point three degrees above nominal, logged as `tolerable.`
Frame transit initiated, spine sequence two-oh-four. We show eleven minutes, gaseous composition nominal. Atmospheric lighting remains engaged.
Expended most of my own samples through the relay. Your cabling held up.

Doorward side is thankless, Sector M. I'll take your flare whenever you wish, but it isn't what we logged the dome for. What I need next is your sensor take -- the one that sees past dead telemetry -- starting from the first hatch.
Site One's intake figures are here. Door breaches, approximate Brood concentrations.
Their repartee carried briefly during the bloom -- not as loud as our Lady in November, alas, but revealing... I have read the word several times since.
The spine is lit from Delta for your benefit, not its own. High-grade synthetic resin with a space reserved explicitly for an honorary third party. (Inspection Agenda Reference 3-C.)
Perimeter is all that holds those terms in position.
You will have it with my tanks just as your route requires it. However, the transmitter hums unquietly today; section reports will never stay uncorrected and magnified.
If I deliver an end of trouble to feed your adders, then transmit.
We will start the sequence. Do close the door behind you -- it only locks after three full cycles.
No one enjoys sitting out. You would not. Even I did not. Transcript archived.
Field log encrypted and transmitting to the Ark.
Running time seventy-nine days -- your last engagement profile resembled --- but we're parsing it out.
Alpha to Zeta all the way down.
Run the capture now. Input the entire run.
Streaming each straight corridor at zero intervals.
Item one sorted then. Second item: rest hours. You receive five, more or less life support permitting -- 'secure sleep' as it reads in the file specification.
Sleeping hours are not strictly enforced by my parameters.
I see death walking a step behind your every sentence should your attention fail during coil maintenance -- call it an affectation of mine for your geometrical shelter.
